description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'git reset --patch' command, including setup, various test cases for resetting patches interactively, and verification of repository state after each operation.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets up the repository with specified file states and saves the current state for later verification.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used in tests to ensure changes are distinguishable.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes to facilitate testing.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD state for verification.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates user input for patch interactively, e.g., lines starting with 'n' or 'y', controlling the patch application.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Checks that the specified files match the expected saved state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that the current repository state matches the expected state after operations.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, verifying proper error handling.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches command output for expected string patterns.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets repository files to specified states for testing.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the HEAD has not shifted unexpectedly.
